gui.guhs.gids.rij.guhrio_kasteel: The Whole Castle in One Go
advancements.guhs.guhrio.root.title: Super Guhrio
advancements.guhs.guhrio.root.descriptio: Find Big Nether Mika's Castle in the frying sauce sea of the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guhshi: Rarity: One per player, after the duel in Big Nether Mika's Castle
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhshi: Guhshi hatches from a speckled egg in the cellars of the castle. He has a big round nose, a little red saddle and orange booties. With you on his back he flutters across the widest gaps, and with his long tongue he snaps Guhmbas and coins right out of the air. Nom-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhrio.vlag: Flag reached! This is where you pop back if things go wrong, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.klaar: Level %s cleared in %s with %s coins. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhrio.klaar.record: Level %s cleared in %s with %s coins. That's your fastest time, wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhrio.geen_level: This start flag doesn't know which level it is (%s), nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.pijp.kanaal: Channel %s (two pipes or two doors with the same channel belong together)
gui.guhs.guhrio.eerst: This gate is still shut. Clear level %s first, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhrio.stoppen: Press Q once more to step out of the level. Nyeg?
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunt: Big Chonk Coin! That's %s of the 3 in this level. Chonk!
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten_alle: All eighteen big chonk coins of the castle are yours. Super wahoog chonk!
gui.guhs.guhrio.ei: Something is moving inside that egg... It's Guhshi's! He'll be waiting for you in the keep, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.geen_ei: Guhshi gives you a puzzled look. He only comes along with whoever found his egg (in the cellars), nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhrio.verdwaald: Hey, how did you get here? This place is for playing only. Toad-guh will pop you back at the gate, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhrio.kasteel: The whole castle in one go: %s. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhrio.kasteel.record: The whole castle in one go: %s. That's your fastest run ever, super wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunt.0: The first big chonk coin of this level
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunt.1: The second big chonk coin of this level
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunt.2: The third big chonk coin of this level
gui.guhs.guhrio.beloning.kasteel: Played through the whole castle in one go (from 1-1 all the way to 3-2)
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten.1_1: All three big chonk coins of level 1-1
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten.1_2: All three big chonk coins of level 1-2
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten.2_1: All three big chonk coins of level 2-1
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten.2_2: All three big chonk coins of level 2-2
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten.3_1: All three big chonk coins of level 3-1
gui.guhs.guhrio.vadsmunten.3_2: All three big chonk coins of level 3-2
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.uitleg: Big Nether Mika has taken Princess Peachguh along 'for a piece of cake'. Six side-scrolling levels and a duel stand between you and the cake. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.stap.7: The duel with Big Nether Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.0: Find Big Nether Mika's Castle in the frying sauce sea and walk through the gate of level 1-1.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.1: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 1-1 (the courtyard) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.1: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.2: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 1-2 (the courtyard) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.2: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.3: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 2-1 (the cellars) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.3: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.4: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 2-2 (the cellars) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.4: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.5: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 3-1 (the keep) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.5: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.6: In the level hall, walk through the gate of level 3-2 (the keep) and reach the flagpole at the end. A and D walk, space bar jumps, S dives into a pipe. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.6: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.7: The big gate at the end of the red carpet is open. Behind it waits Big Nether Mika himself. He only shoves, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.waar.7: The level hall of the castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio.nu.klaar: The castle is completed. Thank you! But feel free to play again: there are bound to be more chonk coins lying around. Wahoog!
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_levels.d: Clear all six levels of Big Nether Mika's Castle
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_vadsmunt: Find all eighteen big chonk coins of the castle
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_duel.des: Win the duel with Big Nether Mika
structure.guhs.guhrio_kasteel.tooltip: Super Guhrio: six side-scrolling levels, a duel and a kidnapped princess (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.guhriow1.geheim.1_1: Secret found: the Mole Hole under the courtyard. The mole is saving up coins, but finders keepers. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.geheim.1_2: Secret found: the gardener's Coin Greenhouse. So THAT'S where they grow. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.vads: All three big chonk coins of level %s are yours. Chonk, chonk, chonk!
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.bedankt: Thank you! But the princess is in another part of the castle, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.verder: Big Nether Mika took her along 'for a piece of cake'. Why not try the cellars: the gate of level 2-1 is open now. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.alweer.0: You again? How cozy! She's still not here, you know. All I've got is a garden. And no cake.
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.alweer.1: Wahoog, you sure are fast. The princess? Oh no. Another part of the castle. Really truly, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.alweer.2: I stand here waving every single time, and every single time I have to say it. Sorry, nyeg. Would you like a flower?
quest.guhs.guhriow1.padguh.praat: Nyeg? How did you get here, right beside the course? The princess is in another part of the castle. I tell everyone that.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.0: A and D walk, space bar jumps. Hold the space bar for a high jump, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.1: Jump up against the Question Block from below. What could be inside?
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.2: A Guhmba! Jump on top of it: flat. From the side it shoves you back to your flag.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.3: Don't step into the cheese pond! Whoever falls in simply pops back at their flag.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.4: Stand on top of the green pipe and dive in with S.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.5: Some blocks hold a Super Nibble. It makes you big, and when you're big you break bricks!
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.6: Stand in front of the door and press W.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.7: A Shell Mika! Jump on it, then kick its shell away: that tidies things up nicely.
gui.guhs.guhriow1.tip.8: What a wide pond! Hold sprint: with a run-up you jump farther.
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w1_binne: In Another Part of the Castle
Clear levels 1-1 and 1-2 of the courtyard, and hear from Toad-guh where the princess is NOT
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w1_tuing: Find the Mole Hole, the Coin Greenhouse and all six big chonk coins of the courtyard
gui.guhs.guhriow2.slot.dicht: The Egg Lock squeaks: no egg, no entry, nyeg! Find Guhshi's Egg (the door under the painted egg).
gui.guhs.guhriow2.slot.open: The Egg Lock sniffs Guhshi's Egg and clicks open. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow2.uit: Guhshi has hatched from his egg! Hop onto the nest and he'll carry you. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow2.warp: Warp! The pipe spits you out in level %s, and that level's gate in the hall stays open for you from now on. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow2.warp.hal: The warp pipe has opened the gate of level %s for you. Go ahead and walk through, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow2.warp.dicht: This warp pipe is clogged. Nyeg?
gui.guhs.guhriow2.vads: All six big chonk coins of the cellars are yours. Cellar chonk!
scene.guhs.guhriow2_uit.leg: You lay the egg in the warm nest.
scene.guhs.guhriow2_uit.rug: Guhshi thinks you're his mama. Go on, hop on his back, nyeg!
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w2_uitge: Find Guhshi's Egg in the cellars and lay it in the warm nest
Find the warp room and let a warp pipe spit you out in another level
gui.guhs.guhriow3.ronde1: Round 1: run underneath him when he jumps and pull the lever, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.hendel: CLICK! Half the bridge flomps into the sauce. "MY BRIDGE!"
gui.guhs.guhriow3.pijp: The green pipe takes you back to the bridge, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow3.ronde2: Round 2: he rolls up in his shell. Jump over it, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.ronde3: Round 3: the ?-block is full again. Grab the Fire Pepper and nibble his shell right back!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.treffer: Bullseye! %s more and he rolls into the sauce, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.plons: SPLASH! (Don't worry: he can swim. He's just very, very offended.)
gui.guhs.guhriow3.gewonnen: You beat Big Nether Mika in %s. He's not mad anymore: he has cake. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriow3.parkeer: Guhshi will wait here for you: fire peppers make him sneeze, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow3.peper_guhshi: You don't throw nibbles while riding Guhshi (he gobbles them up himself). Leave him at a hitching post first, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriow3.padguh: Toad-guh: Psst! Behind that really big gate with the horns it smells like cake. THAT'S where you need to be, I think. Wahoog lots of luck, nyeg!
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.mok: Hmph. Wet. Sticky. And still no cake. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.herrie: Yoo-hoo! Who's making such a racket on my bridge?
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.redden: Did you come to rescue me? How sweet! But I wasn't kidnapped at all, nyeg. I was here baking a cake.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.stukje: I only wanted a piece. But nobody ever invites a Big Nether Mika over for cake...
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.vragen: Then why not just ask, you big chonker? Here. The biggest piece is for you.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.voor_mij: FOR ME?! ...Wahoog. But next time I win. After the cake.
scene.guhs.guhriow3_einde.torenkamer: Come along to the tower room: there's plenty for everyone. Chonk for all guhs!
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.guhriow3_duel.tit: The Duel with Big Nether Mika
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.guhriow3_duel.reg: Behind the big gate he waits: Big Nether Mika, with horns, a red mane and a shell full of spikes.
He only shoves. Whoever gets bumped or falls into the sauce is right back at their flag.
Three rounds: run underneath him to the lever, jump over his rolling shell, and nibble that shell right back with a Fire Pepper.
And don't forget what it was all about: a piece of cake. Nyeg!
advancements.guhs.guhrio.guhrio_w3_taart: See how it all turns out for Big Nether Mika, Princess Peachguh and the cake
